explanation: This component is 0 at every D1 and GO step and only turns on at D2, where it is 0 whenever the previous trial was rewarded. When the previous trial was unrewarded it is usually about 2-3, but it jumps to 7-10 when the agent has had two or more unrewarded trials in a row, especially in trials 8-55 (choosing a2 or reaching S2 gives the highest values); a single loss inside a long rewarded run, or late in the episode, stays at 0-3.
